text:
As a foreigner and a student, I was looking for a budget-friendly dental clinic where I could solve my tooth problem. Then I found this CLASS Dental, which was pretty okay for braces, like both up and down teeth braces for 1500 baht per month. Dr. Fah is a nice and kind dentist. She is a very good listener and knows how to solve the problem of my teeth. However, when the time came for wisdom tooth removal, I was told that each tooth would cost 1500 baht only, then the day I went for my tooth removal, they told me I had to pay 5000 Bhat for each tooth! Which is ridiculous at that moment. And I wasn't ready to pay 20,000 baht to pay for 4 tooth wisdom removals. Not only that ridiculous amount of money but also, the reception lady with a big face (probably the manager) was rude as well. I never liked her behavior and of course her service.
I didn't do my removal in this clinic, nor do I go back there anymore. They kept calling me to go back but I found a better dental clinic. Sometimes good behavior and good service with a smile can make a change, which CLASS Dental failed to achieve.
Also, they don't care about appointment time, every time I reach there on time or even a few minutes earlier but every time I have to wait there for 30-40 or 1 hour. So making an appointment is useless, no value of time.
Furthermor, I do not recommend this clinic for foreigners who don't speak Thai at all. Or go there at your own risk.
P.S.: I would give 0 stars to the receptionists and their service, but I give 4 stars to Dr. Fah
